service: O-QT — OECD QSAR Toolbox AI Assistant
description: O-QT (OECD QSAR Toolbox AI Assistant) is a modular, multi-agent system that interfaces directly with the locally running OECD QSAR Toolbox Web API. It automates the end-to-end process of chemical profiling, hazard characterization, and read-across justification through LLM-guided reasoning. The assistant retrieves chemical properties, experimental data, and profiling outputs from the Toolbox, and synthesizes them into an auditable, AI-generated report suitable for early-stage hazard identification and NGRA workflows. Designed for transparency and reproducibility, O-QT operates locally via Docker, ensuring data privacy while leveraging the interpretive capacity of modern LLMs.

access.API: OECD QSAR Toolbox WebAPI (local installation required)
access.login: Requires a locally installed OECD QSAR Toolbox with Web API enabled on Windows. Set the environment variable QSAR_TOOLBOX_API_URL to point to your local instance. Provide an OpenAI API key or OpenRouter API key for AI-assisted analysis.
access.security: Data privacy preserved through local execution; no proprietary chemical data is transmitted externally.

workflow.title: Agent Workflow — Context → Specialists → Read-Across → Synthesis
workflow.description: O-QT decomposes the chemical analysis task into multiple specialized agents: (1) Context Agent for study framing and data selection; (2) Profiling and Property Agents interfacing with the QSAR Toolbox API; (3) Read-Across Agent to infer analogs and mechanistic similarities; and (4) Synthesis Agent generating an interpretive, human-readable report. The workflow is orchestrated through LLM prompts with persistent reasoning chains.

faqs.What does O-QT do?: It automates the OECD QSAR Toolbox workflows, using AI agents to retrieve, interpret, and report hazard profiling data in structured formats.
faqs.How does it connect to the Toolbox?: It communicates via the OECD QSAR Toolbox Web API, available when the Toolbox is running locally in API mode.
faqs.Where can I download the OECD QSAR Toolb: The Toolbox can be downloaded for free from the OECD website at https://qsartoolbox.org/download/.
faqs.Is my chemical data shared externally?: No. All data remains within the local environment. The AI model only processes summaries or structured data in memory.
faqs.What LLMs are supported?: O-QT can use OpenAI (e.g., GPT-4.1 series or GPT5) or OpenRouter-compatible APIs for reasoning and report synthesis.
faqs.Can I run it offline?: Yes, all computations occur locally on your personal OECD QSAR Toolbox, except for the LLM API calls which require internet connectivity, however it is possible to use local models
